spec.description: CloudBatchResourceAllowanceSpec defines the desired state of CloudBatchResourceAllowance

labels.description: Optional. Labels are attributes that can be set and used by both the user and by Batch.

pubsubTopicRef.description: Required. The Pub/Sub topic where notifications like the resource allowance state changes will be published.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed PubSubTopic resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/topics/{{topicID}}".

name.description: The name of a PubSubTopic resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a PubSubTopic resource.

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

resourceID.description: The CloudBatchResourceAllowance name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

usageResourceAllowance.description: The detail of usage resource allowance.

spec.description: Required. Spec of a usage ResourceAllowance.

limit.description: Required. Threshold of a UsageResourceAllowance limiting how many resources can be consumed for each type.

calendarPeriod.description: Optional. A CalendarPeriod represents the abstract concept of a time period that has a canonical start.

limit.description: Required. Limit value of a UsageResourceAllowance within its one duration.

type.description: Required. Spec type is unique for each usage ResourceAllowance. Batch now only supports type as "cpu-core-hours" for CPU usage consumption tracking.

status.description: CloudBatchResourceAllowanceStatus defines the config connector machine state of CloudBatchResourceAllowance

conditions.description: Conditions represent the latest available observations of the object's current state.

lastTransitionTime.description: Last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.

message.description: Human-readable message indicating details about last transition.

reason.description: Unique, one-word, CamelCase reason for the condition's last transition.

status.description: Status is the status of the condition. Can be True, False, Unknown.

type.description: Type is the type of the condition.

externalRef.description: A unique specifier for the CloudBatchResourceAllowance resource in GCP.

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the generation of the resource that was most recently observed by the Config Connector controller. If this is equal to metadata.generation, then that means that the current reported status reflects the most recent desired state of the resource.

observedState.description: ObservedState is the state of the resource as most recently observed in GCP.

createTime.description: Output only. Time when the ResourceAllowance was created.

uid.description: Output only. A system generated unique ID (in UUID4 format) for the ResourceAllowance.

usageResourceAllowance.description: The detail of usage resource allowance.

status.description: Output only. Status of a usage ResourceAllowance.

limitStatus.description: Output only. ResourceAllowance consumption status for usage resources.

endTime.description: Optional. Exclusive end of the interval.

startTime.description: Optional. Inclusive start of the interval.

limit.description: Output only. Limit value of a UsageResourceAllowance within its one duration.

report.description: Output only. The report of ResourceAllowance consumptions in a time period.

latestPeriodConsumptions.description: Output only. ResourceAllowance consumptions in the latest calendar period. Key is the calendar period in string format. Batch currently supports HOUR, DAY, MONTH and YEAR.

endTime.description: Optional. Exclusive end of the interval.

startTime.description: Optional. Inclusive start of the interval.
